alt: Four warning cards: rules, a locked account, no official promise, and spoilers if you wait.

data.title: The four risks

cards.title: Rules
cards.body: Sony and Microsoft have rules on regional accounts and purchases (BBC).

cards.title: Your account
cards.body: Breaking those rules could mean account limits or losing digital games (BBC).

cards.title: No promise
cards.body: Rockstar, Take-Two, Sony and Microsoft have not commented. It may not work.

cards.title: Spoilers
cards.body: People in New Zealand play 12 hours earlier. Story surprises can spread online.

data.note: We do not recommend this. It is not approved.
